mapper.select: SELECT r.conversation_id AS conversationId, c.title AS title, COUNT(*) AS runCount, MAX(r.id) AS lastRunId, MAX(r.create_time) AS lastTime FROM ai_agent_run r LEFT JOIN ai_chat_conversation c ON r.conversation_id = c.id AND c.deleted = 0 WHERE r.user_id = #{userId} AND r.trigger_type = 'CONVERSATION' AND r.conversation_id IS NOT NULL AND r.deleted = 0 GROUP BY r.conversation_id, c.title ORDER BY lastRunId DESC LIMIT 100
